# Docs capabilities

<!-- Generated by `bun run capabilities`; do not edit by hand. -->

17 operations, all REST methods. ⚠️ marks destructive operations (MCP `destructiveHint`): removals, sends, and standing side effects.

| Operation | Source | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`get_document`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/get) | REST Method | Get a document by id: its title, revision, and body as text blocks with UTF-16 index ranges (the ranges that edits target). |
| [`create_document`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/create) | REST Method | Create a blank document with a title; returns the new document and its id. Body content is added with the editing operations. |
| [`insert_text`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertTextRequest) | REST Method | Insert text into a document body, at a UTF-16 index or (omitted) appended at the end. |
| [`replace_all_text`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#ReplaceAllTextRequest) ⚠️ | REST Method | Replace every occurrence of a substring in the document, irreversibly; returns how many occurrences changed. |
| [`delete_content_range`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#DeleteContentRangeRequest) ⚠️ | REST Method | Delete a UTF-16 index range of document content, irreversibly; indices shift afterward, so re-read before further edits. |
| [`update_text_style`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#UpdateTextStyleRequest) | REST Method | Set character styling (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, small caps, baseline offset, font size, font family and weight, foreground and background color, link) on a range of text; only the provided fields change. |
| [`update_paragraph_style`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#UpdateParagraphStyleRequest) | REST Method | Set paragraph styling (named style such as headings, alignment, line spacing, direction, spacing, indents, borders, shading, pagination controls) on every paragraph a range overlaps; only the provided fields change. |
| [`create_paragraph_bullets`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#CreateParagraphBulletsRequest) | REST Method | Turn the paragraphs a range overlaps into a bulleted or numbered list, using a glyph preset; leading tabs determine nesting. |
| [`delete_paragraph_bullets`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#DeleteParagraphBulletsRequest) ⚠️ | REST Method | Remove bullets from the paragraphs a range overlaps; the text is preserved and the paragraphs leave their list. |
| [`update_document_style`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#UpdateDocumentStyleRequest) | REST Method | Set document-wide styling (page margins, header and footer margins, page size and orientation, page number start, first- and even-page header toggles, background color); only the provided fields change. |
| [`insert_section_break`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertSectionBreakRequest) | REST Method | Insert a section break (new-page or continuous) into the document body, splitting the document into sections that update_section_style can style independently; a newline character is inserted before the break. |
| [`update_section_style`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#UpdateSectionStyleRequest) | REST Method | Set section styling (column layout and separators, content direction, section margins) on every section a range overlaps; only the provided fields change. Sections are created with insert_section_break; a document with no breaks is one section. |
| [`insert_table`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertTableRequest) | REST Method | Insert an empty table with the given number of rows and columns; a newline character is inserted before the table, so the table starts one index past the insertion point. Re-read the document afterwards to target the new cells. |
| [`insert_table_row`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertTableRowRequest) | REST Method | Insert an empty row into a table, above or below the row of a reference cell. Re-read the document afterwards: the insertion shifts every index at or after the new row. |
| [`insert_table_column`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#InsertTableColumnRequest) | REST Method | Insert an empty column into a table, to the left or right of the column of a reference cell. Re-read the document afterwards: the insertion shifts indices throughout the table. |
| [`delete_table_row`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#DeleteTableRowRequest) ⚠️ | REST Method | Delete the table row a reference cell spans, including all cell content; a merged cell spanning multiple rows deletes them all, and deleting the last row deletes the whole table. |
| [`delete_table_column`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#DeleteTableColumnRequest) ⚠️ | REST Method | Delete the table column a reference cell spans, including all cell content; a merged cell spanning multiple columns deletes them all, and deleting the last column deletes the whole table. |
